adds.title: Qanun Jinayat (2014 Aceh Sharia Criminal Code)
adds.summary: Qanun Aceh Nomor 6 Tahun 2014 tentang Hukum Jinayat enacted in 2014 and enforced from 23 October 2015 defines liwath in Article 63 as sexual acts between males and musahaqah in Article 64 as sexual acts between females as determined by birth sex and punishes each with up to 100 lashes, up to 100 months imprisonment, or a fine of up to 1,000 grams of gold, thereby exposing trans visitors in Aceh to caning, imprisonment and fines where presentation, identity documents, or partner sex are policed as same-sex conduct.

adds.title: 2017 Aceh public caning case - two young gay men aged 20 and 23
adds.summary: Aceh is Indonesia's only province that criminalizes same-sex relations and enforces Islamic law in addition to the national criminal code, and on May 23, 2017 in Banda Aceh an Islamic court applied its 2014 anti-homosexuality provisions for the first time by having two men publicly caned with 82 lashes each for gay sex before hundreds of spectators outside a mosque.
